card.summary_ko: 1906년 대한자강회의 발기 취지서. 국권 상실의 원인을 자강의 길을 힘쓰지 않은 데서 찾고, 교육 진흥과 산업 육성으로 국권 회복을 꾀하자고 호소한다.
card.summary_en: The 1906 founding prospectus of the Korean Self-Strengthening Society: it blames lost sovereignty on neglect of self-strengthening and calls for education and industry as the road to recovery.
card.edition_ko: 국사편찬위원회 한국사데이터베이스 전사본(ma_001_0010_0030), 『대한자강회월보』 제1호, 원문 퍼블릭 도메인
card.edition_en: National Institute of Korean History database transcription (ma_001_0010_0030), Daehan Jagang-hoe Wolbo no. 1; original public domain

notes.ko:
**저자** 대한자강회는 1906년에 서울에서 조직된 계몽·정치 단체로, 취지서에는 발기인 장지연(張志淵, 1864–1921)·윤효정(尹孝定, 1858–1939으로 알려짐)·심의성·임진수·김상범이 이름을 올렸다. 장지연은 《황성신문》 주필로 1905년 〈시일야방성대곡〉을 쓴 것으로 널리 알려졌고, 윤효정은 독립협회 활동 이후 개신 유교·애국계몽 노선에 섰다. 이 단체는 교육과 산업을 통한 '실력 양성'으로 국권 회복을 꾀한 애국계몽운동(자강운동) 계열로 분류된다. 무력 투쟁이 아니라 합법적 계몽과 점진적 개혁을 내세웠고, 이런 노선은 일제의 통치를 사실상 받아들이는 것이라는 비판과 시대적 한계로 이해해야 한다는 평가가 함께 있다. 일부 인물은 훗날 행적이 논란이 되기도 한다.

**시대적 맥락** 1905년 을사늑약으로 대한제국은 외교권을 잃고 통감부가 설치되었다. 이후 국권을 되찾기 위한 길로 의병 투쟁과 함께 교육·산업·언론을 통한 '자강'을 주장하는 단체들이 생겨났다. 대한자강회는 그 가운데 대표적인 단체로, 월보를 내고 강연회를 열었다. 1907년 고종 강제 퇴위 때 반대 운동을 벌인 일로 같은 해(1907년 8월경) 통감부의 명령으로 해산되었다고 알려져 있다. 정확한 근거 법령은 여기서 확인하지 않았다. 이 모임의 인맥은 이후 대한협회로 이어졌다.

**배경** 광무 10년(1906) 3월 31일자로 작성되어 《대한자강회월보》 제1호(1906년 7월)에 실렸다. 여기서는 국사편찬위원회 한국사데이터베이스의 전사본을 사용했다. 이 전사본은 일부 동사 어미의 '하'가 빠져 있고(예: 不講於自强之術'야') 몇몇 글자가 비슷한 글자로 바뀌어 있는데(예: 已→巳·己), 이는 원 자료의 상태이며 번역은 의도된 뜻을 따랐다. 2번째 단락은 문장 중간(“有志”)에서 끊기고 3번째 단락 “僉君子는”으로 이어진다.

**의의** 취지서는 국권 상실의 원인을 '자강의 길을 힘쓰지 않은 것'에서 찾고, 그 해법으로 교육 진흥과 산업 육성, 그리고 단군·기자 이래의 '국민 정신'을 강조한다. 애국계몽운동의 논리를 압축한 대표적 문서로 읽힌다.

**형식과 주제** 국한문 혼용체로, 한문 문장 구조에 한글 조사·어미(은/는, 이면, 하야)를 붙였다. 주제는 자강, 교육, 식산(殖産), 국민 정신, 단결이다. 중국 고사(초나라 포로, 신정의 눈물, 위 문공, 연나라의 노래)와 프로이센의 사례를 들어 설득한다.

**읽기 도움** 自强(자강, 스스로 강해짐), 因循玩愒(인순완갈, 구태에 머물러 시간을 허비함), 汲汲(급급, 서두름), 殖産興業(식산흥업, 산업을 일으킴), 僉君子(첨군자, 여러분), 復權(복권, 국권을 되찾음), 腦髓(뇌수), 權輿(권여, 시작), ᄒᆞ야/ᄂᆞᆫ(아래아 표기, 현대어 하야·는). 현대어 층은 한자어를 한글로 옮겨 적은 것이다.
notes.en:
**About the author** The Korean Self-Strengthening Society (Daehan Jagang-hoe) was an enlightenment and political society organised in Seoul in 1906; the prospectus lists as founders Jang Ji-yeon (1864–1921), Yun Hyo-jeong (1858–1939, as generally given), Sim Ui-seong, Im Jin-su and Gim Sang-beom. Jang Ji-yeon, chief editor of the Hwangseong Sinmun, is widely known as the author of the 1905 editorial "Sii-ya bang-seong daegok"; Yun Hyo-jeong moved from Independence Club activity to a reformist-Confucian, patriotic-enlightenment line. The society is classed with the patriotic enlightenment (jagang, "self-strengthening") movement, which sought recovery of sovereignty through "building capacity" in education and industry. Its stress on legal enlightenment and gradual reform rather than armed struggle is criticised by some as in effect accepting Japanese rule and understood by others as a limit of its time; the later careers of some figures are also debated.

**Historical context** The 1905 Protectorate Treaty took away the Korean Empire's diplomatic rights and a Resident-General's office was set up. Alongside the righteous armies, societies arose arguing for "self-strengthening" through education, industry and the press. The Jagang-hoe was a leading one, publishing a monthly and holding lectures. It is said to have campaigned against the forced abdication of Emperor Gojong in 1907 and to have been dissolved the same year (around August 1907) on the Resident-General's orders; the exact legal basis was not verified here. Its membership continued in the Korean Association (Daehan Hyeophoe).

**Background** Written on 31 March 1906 (Gwangmu 10) and printed in the Society's monthly no. 1 (July 1906). The text here is the transcription of the National Institute of Korean History database. This transcription lacks some Hangul 하 in verb endings (e.g. 不講於自强之術'야') and has some look-alike character substitutions (e.g. 已 written 巳 or 己); that is the source's state, and the translation follows the intended sense. Paragraph 2 breaks mid-sentence ("有志") and continues in paragraph 3 ("僉君子는").

**Significance** The prospectus locates the cause of the loss of sovereignty in not having striven for self-strengthening, and proposes as the remedy the promotion of education and industry together with a "national spirit" traced from Dangun and Gija. It is read as a compact statement of the patriotic-enlightenment argument.

**Form and themes** Mixed Sino-Korean script: classical Chinese sentence structure with Hangul particles and endings (은/는, 이면, 하야). Themes: self-strengthening, education, industry, national spirit, unity. It persuades with Chinese allusions (the captives of Chu, the tears at Xinting, Duke Wen of Wey, the songs of Yan) and the example of Prussia.

**Reading help** 自强 (jagang, strengthening oneself), 因循玩愒 (insun-wangal, clinging to old ways and wasting time), 汲汲 (geupgeup, in haste), 殖産興業 (sikssan-heungeop, fostering industry), 僉君子 (cheom-gunja, gentlemen all), 復權 (gwonbok, regaining sovereignty), 腦髓 (naesu, brain), 權輿 (gwonyeo, beginning), ᄒᆞ야/ᄂᆞᆫ (arae-a spelling, modern 하야/는). The modern layer renders the Sino-Korean words in Hangul.

paragraphs.en: Prospectus of the Korean Self-Strengthening Society

paragraphs.orig: 夫 邦國之獨立은 惟在自强之如何耳라. 我韓이 從前不講於自强之術ᄒᆞ야 人民이 自錮於愚昧ᄒᆞ고 國力이 自趂於衰敗ᄒᆞ야 遂至於今日之艱棘ᄒᆞ야 竟被外人之保護ᄒᆞ니 此 皆不致意於自强之道故也라 尙此因循玩愒ᄒᆞ야 不思奮勵自强之術이면 終底於滅亡而乃己니 奚但今日而止哉아. 嗚呼라 有志憂國之士가 或仰天太息ᄒᆞ며 或據地痛哭이 固是不能目已者나 然이나 楚囚相對에 徒下新亭之淚ᄒᆞ고 燕歌慷慨에 空懷不平之恨이 於國何益이며 於君何補哉아 昔衛文公之中興은 基本於殖産ᄒᆞ고 普魯士之振起ᄂᆞᆫ 功在於學校ᄒᆞ니 彼皆無忘於與復之念而講究於自强之術 故로 乃能成就其大業而遺蹟於後世者也라. 今 我韓은 三千里彊土가 無缺ᄒᆞ고 二千萬民族이 自在ᄒᆞ니 苟能奮勵自强ᄒᆞ야 團體共合이면 猶可望富强之前途而國權之回復也라 迨此 今日ᄒᆞ야 豈非汲汲奮發之時乎아 然이나 如究其自强之術이면 無他라 在振作敎育也요 在殖産興業也니 夫敎育이 不興則民智未開ᄒᆞ고産業이 不殖則國富莫增ᄒᆞᄂᆞ니 然則開民智養國力之道ᄂᆞᆫ 亶不在敎育産業之發達乎아 是知敎育産業之發達이 卽惟ㅡ自强之術巳라. 雖然이나 抑欲貫徹 此 自强之目的인ᄃᆡᆫ 不得不先培養 其國民之精神ᄒᆞ야 使檀 箕以來四千年自國之精神으로 灌注於二千萬人人之腦髓ᄒᆞ야 一呼吸一瞬息之頃이라도 不忘於自强之 精神 然後에야 方可鍊自强之心膽而作復權之活機也리니 內養其祖國之精神ᄒᆞ며 外吸乎文明之學術이 卽今日時局之急務也 ᅟᅵᆯᄉᆡ 此ㅣ 自强會之所以發起者也라. 惟我全國有志
paragraphs.modern: 부 방국지독립은 유재자강지여하이라. 아한이 종전불강어자강지술하야 인민이 자고어우매하고 국력이 자진어쇠패하야 수지어금일지간극하야 경피외인지보호하니 차 개불치의어자강지도고야라. 상차인순완갈하야 불사분려자강지술이면 종저어멸망이내이니 해단금일이지재아. 오호라 유지우국지사가 혹앙천태식하며 혹거지통곡이 고시불능목이자나 연이나 초수상대에 도하신정지루하고 연가강개에 공회불평지한이 어국하익이며 어군하보재아. 석위문공지중흥은 기본어식산하고 보로사지진기는 공재어학교하니 피개무망어여복지념이강구어자강지술 고로 내능성취기대업이유적어후세자야라. 금 아한은 삼천리강토가 무결하고 이천만민족이 자재하니 구능분려자강하야 단체공합이면 유가망부강지전도이국권지회복야라 태차 금일하야 기비급급분발지시호아. 연이나 여구기자강지술이면 무타라 재진작교육야요 재식산흥업야니 부교육이 불흥즉민지미개하고 산업이 불식즉국부막증하나니 연즉개민지양국력지도는 단부재교육산업지발달호아 시지교육산업지발달이 즉유일자강지술이라. 수연이나 억욕관철 차 자강지목적인댄 부득불선배양 기국민지정신하야 사단기이래사천년자국지정신으로 관주어이천만인인지뇌수하야 일호흡일순식지경이라도 불망어자강지 정신 연후에야 방가련자강지심담이작복권지활기야리니 내양기조국지정신하며 외흡호문명지학술이 즉금일시국지급무야 일새 차가 자강회지소이발기자야라. 유아전국유지
paragraphs.en: Whether a nation stands independent depends solely on how strong it makes itself. Our Korea, having in the past not studied the arts of self-strengthening, has seen its people shut themselves up in ignorance and its national strength sink of itself into decay, until at last it has come to today's hardship and has even been placed under the "protection" of a foreign power; all this is because we paid no heed to the way of self-strengthening. If we still drift on in this fashion, idling and wasting time, with no thought of striving at the arts of self-strengthening, we shall end in nothing but destruction -- and would it stop at today alone? Alas! Patriots who care for the country may look up to heaven and heave great sighs, or sit on the ground and weep bitterly; these are feelings no one can help. Yet what use is it to the country, what help to the sovereign, if, like the captives of Chu facing one another, we merely shed tears at the Xinting pavilion, or, in the stirring songs of Yan, vainly nurse a grudge and discontent? Duke Wen of Wey's restoration had its foundation in the promotion of production, and the rise of Prussia owed its achievement to schools. Neither forgot the thought of recovery, and both studied the arts of self-strengthening; therefore they were able to achieve great enterprises and leave their traces to later ages. Now our Korea has its three thousand ri of territory without loss and its twenty million people still present; if only we can strive with all our might at self-strengthening and join together in united bodies, we may still hope for a path to wealth and strength and for the recovery of national sovereignty. Is this not, now, the time for earnest and urgent exertion? Yet if we examine the arts of self-strengthening, there is no other: it lies in promoting education and in fostering industry. Without the flourishing of education the people's intelligence is not opened, and without the growth of industry the nation's wealth cannot increase. Then is not the way to open the people's intelligence and nourish the nation's strength nothing other than the development of education and industry? From this we know that the development of education and industry is the one art of self-strengthening. Even so, if we wish to carry through this aim of self-strengthening, we must first cultivate the spirit of the nation's people, so that the spirit of the fatherland of four thousand years, since Dangun and Gija, is poured into the brain of each of the twenty million, so that not for a single breath or a single instant do they forget the spirit of self-strengthening. Only then can we temper the heart and courage of self-strengthening and create the living mechanism for regaining sovereignty. To nourish within the spirit of the homeland and to draw in from without the learning of civilisation is the urgent task of the present situation; this is why this Society has been launched. Of all those in our whole country with ambition for the nation

paragraphs.orig: 僉君子ᄂᆞᆫ 孰無慷慨回復國權之想哉아 請勿躕躇ᄒᆞ고 同此血性ᄒᆞ야 亟亟奮發於自强之術而烝進於回復之途則大韓獨立之基礎가 必權輿於此矣니 玆豈非全國之幸福也哉아.
paragraphs.modern: 첨군자는 숙무강개회복국권지상재아 청물주저하고 동차혈성하야 극극분발어자강지술이증진어회복지도즉대한독립지기초가 필권여어차의니 자기비전국지행복야재아.
paragraphs.en: Gentlemen all, who among you has no passionate thought of recovering national sovereignty? We ask you not to hesitate, but to share this ardent nature with us, to exert yourselves urgently in the arts of self-strengthening and advance step by step on the road to recovery; then the foundation of Korean independence will surely have its beginning here. Is this not the happiness of the whole nation?

paragraphs.orig: 光武十年三月三十一日 發起人 張志淵 尹孝定 沈宜性 林珍洙 金相範
paragraphs.modern: 광무십년삼월삼십일일 발기인 장지연 윤효정 심의성 임진수 김상범
paragraphs.en: The tenth year of Gwangmu, third month, thirty-first day. Founders: Jang Ji-yeon, Yun Hyo-jeong, Sim Ui-seong, Im Jin-su, Gim Sang-beom.

review.notes: Orig complete; modern is Hangul transliteration with same meaning; en faithful. Signature reads 尹孝定 (catalogue note's 尹孝正 is the error; enriched notes already use 윤효정/尹孝定). Fixed para-number in notes, opening of para 3 en, hedged dissolution (1907, legal basis unverified) and Yun's dates. Left: raw meta pd_basis says 윤효정 1929 vs notes 1939.
